events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Alec Burleson delivered a two-run double early and four St. Louis relievers turned in perfect innings late, helping the Cardinals beat the Cincinnati Reds 2-1 in the first game of a doubleheader Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alec Burleson and a stout bullpen lead the Cardinals over the Reds 2-1 in Game 1 of doubleheader

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Jonny DeLuca put the Rays in front with a two-run single in the seventh inning, and AL-best Tampa Bay rallied for a 7-6 win over the Baltimore Orioles on Monday night to avoid a four-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonny DeLuca's 2-run single completes Rays' rally for 7-6 win over Orioles to avoid sweep

headlines.description: — Cristopher Sánchez struck out six over six solid innings and became baseball’s first 16-game winner as the Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the Miami Marlins 6-5 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cristopher Sánchez gets 16th win with 6 solid innings as Phillies outlast Marlins 6-5

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz delivered his first career walk-off hit in the 10th inning after Dane Myers hit a tying pinch-hit homer in the ninth, and the Cincinnati Reds rallied past the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5 on Monday night to split a doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: De La Cruz's 1st career walk-off hit in 10th gives Reds 6-5 win over Cardinals to split doubleheader

headlines.description: — Kevin McGonigle hit a two-run homer, and the Detroit Tigers held off the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-5 on Monday night and moved into a three-way tie for the final AL wild-card spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: McGonigle homers as Tigers beat Pirates 8-5 and move into a tie for the last AL wild-card spot

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Willson Contreras and Mickey Gasper homered, all nine Boston starters drove in at least one, and the Red Sox dismantled the Arizona Diamondbacks 11-1 on Monday night in the first game of a three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox overwhelm Diamondbacks 11-1 as all 9 starters drive in a run

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Bobby Witt Jr. had a two-run homer, an RBI double and scored four times, leading the Kansas City Royals to a 9-5 victory over the Athletics on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bobby Witt Jr. homers and scores 4 runs in the Royals' 9-5 win over the Athletics

headlines.description: — Josh Bell’s two-run double started the scoring in a four-run first inning, and the Minnesota Twins held on to beat the Atlanta Braves 4-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Bell has early 2-run double and Twins bullpen makes lead hold up for 4-2 win over Braves
